Title: Azure Purview available in public preview in South Central US and Canada Central

Body.Content:
Azure Purview is now available in public preview in the South Central US and Canada Central Azure regions. You can now provision Azure Purview accounts in these regions as a public preview offering. 

To get started with the service, see Quickstart: Create an Azure Purview account in the Azure portal.

For the full set of regions that Azure Purview is currently available in as a public preview offering, see Azure Purview Availability.
